content.content: When invoked as `deccy undo`, the deccy CLI shall undo an operation whole — reverting its own entries, or removing the created node entire.
content.rationale: An operation is undone whole, not as its entries alone: D8a (prsoxsuo) makes a creation's undo the removal of the created node and a recording's or removal's the restoration of what it changed. Stating the whole operation gives the leg, gate, and scope something to pin down.
